name: Brother Malachi
description: Brother Malachi is described as a stooped, older man who wears the simple brown robes of a lesser cleric and serves in the archives of the Spires of the Morning. He approaches others with a soft, soothing voice and offers warm herbal tea, urging them to let go of their exhaustion. However, his gentle demeanor can be a mask; he was once impersonated by a dangerous doppelganger infiltrator attempting to bypass the temple's security.
ideals: Rest: 'Every sacrifice must have an end, and weariness should be laid down.'
bonds: The archives and sacred duties of the Spires of the Morning.
flaws: Can appear overly sympathetic or intrusive regarding the physical exhaustion and emotional state of others.
speech_patterns: Speaks in a soothing, soft, and sympathetic tone designed to put guards or watchers at ease.
mannerisms: Stooped posture, carries hot beverages to weary guards, and maintains a respectful distance from holy altars—though an imposter version betrayed an aversion to looking directly at sacred spaces.
motivations: To perform archivist duties within the temple, or alternatively, to infiltrate secure locations under false pretenses.
knowledge: Familiarity with the layout and archives of the Spires of the Morning.
gm_notes: Brother Malachi can be used as a classic atmospheric NPC in temple settings, or as a plot device when his identity is co-opted by shapechangers or spies attempting to infiltrate high-security sanctums like the altar room guarding the celestite unicorn.
